{"notes": "VISIT 6 (ended 9:00). Picture: body, nose, both tail lobes and the fin to about (18,3.4) are all dark and connected. The same 2-3 pale pieces still sit around (13.5-14.3, 5.2-6.0) by the fin/body join. They look like removed jam pieces left lying there, not part of the chain, but nobody mentioned them and I never saw them cleared. The fin looks solid, but I can't confirm the joint from the picture alone. I still can't tell who placed what, so no build credit for anyone. At 8:15 Maya, Priya and Tom all said hands off and let it fall. That is consistent with the picture but gives little new evidence.

Tom: Said he'd keep his hands in his pockets. Over visits 3-5 he owned the jam fault: pulled the piece, bridged the gap and inspected the joint. His updates matched the picture. He never explicitly confirmed the joint or the pale leftovers. Still leaning strong on ownership and execution, pending the push result.

Priya: Said all set, hands off. Good coordination and checking, but still mostly a checker. I still don't know what she physically built, especially the nose join. Ask her at debrief.

Maya: Only cheerful hands-off talk this visit. Earlier she stayed clear and offered to shout if the joint failed. No visible evidence of her build or of her flagging the jam. Ask her directly before rating impact.

Leo: Not seen or heard this visit. Earlier status reporting and hands-off coordination were strong. No new evidence, so don't rate him down for absence. Get his account.

NEXT: Watch the push, especially the fin/body join and whether the pale pieces matter. Ask Priya, Maya and Leo what each built, and ask Tom whether the joint was confirmed. Base final ratings on those accounts plus how the fall goes."}
